label: Algorithms & Data Structures
brief: Create five clean, futuristic computer science vectors: binary search tree, consistent hash ring, DAG, self-attention matrix, and state machine graph.

items.name: Binary Search Tree
items.description: Balanced binary tree graph with highlighted traversal path.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a balanced binary tree hierarchy with connected circular nodes and one highlighted traversal branch; no text or numbers inside nodes.

items.name: Consistent Hash Ring
items.description: Circular hash ring with partitioned virtual nodes and keys.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a circular ring with evenly spaced perimeter node markers and connecting partition chords; no text or numbers.

items.name: Directed Acyclic Graph
items.description: Topological DAG showing dependency workflow with directional edges.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a crisp directed acyclic graph (DAG) with interconnected circular nodes and clean arrowed dependency edges; no text.

items.name: Self-Attention Graph
items.description: Bipartite multi-head attention interconnect showing weighted neural links.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a bipartite neural network attention layer with parallel query-key nodes connected by weighted glowing link rays; no text.

items.name: Finite State Machine
items.description: Finite state automaton with transition arcs and accept state rings.
items.generation_prompt: Draw a finite state machine graph with circular state nodes, transition loop arcs, and a double-ring accept state; no text inside nodes.
